title: Warning notice.
officialText:
The following permanent notice, constructed of approved material, shall be mechanically attached to
the sauna room on the outside:
WARNING: DO NOT EXCEED 30 MINUTES IN SAUNA. EXCESSIVE EXPOSURE CAN BE HARMFUL TO
HEALTH. ANY PERSON WITH POOR HEALTH SHOULD CONSULT A PHYSICIAN BEFORE USING SAUNA.
The words shall contrast with the background and the wording shall be in letters not less than 0.25-inch (6.4 mm) high.
Exception: This section shall not apply to one- and two-family dwellings.
SECTION MC 915
ENGINE AND GAS TURBINE-POWERED
EQUIPMENT AND APPLIANCES
